verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page claims that users can describe a control and have built-in AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence on a schedule. That is a first-party form of delegating tasks to AI, but it rests on a single marketing line and covers only evidence collection. The MCP server and service keys connect external assistants to Oneleet, so they are not a built-in assistant and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: confirmation that Fieldwork's agents run inside the core Oneleet platform, a general-purpose in-product assistant for delegating varied tasks, detailed docs on how delegation works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
